features.name: Gateway Arch
features.description: The 630-foot stainless-steel Gateway Arch is viewed freely from the grounds; entering the underground complex requires the west entrance and security screening.

details.positionQuality: Gateway Arch National Park, 11, Saint Louis, Missouri, 63102, United States
details.imageAlt: Gateway Arch at Gateway Arch National Park

features.name: Museum at the Gateway Arch
features.description: The free underground museum interprets Indigenous, colonial, expansion, migration and civil-rights histories and can be visited without buying a tram ticket.

details.positionQuality: Museum at the Gateway Arch, Gateway Arch Trail, Downtown, Saint Louis, Missouri, 63102, United States
details.imageAlt: Museum at the Gateway Arch at Gateway Arch National Park

features.name: Tram Ride to the Top
features.description: The ticketed tram uses compact enclosed capsules to reach the observation deck; advance reservations are recommended and the experience is not wheelchair accessible.

details.positionQuality: Approximate mapped position within Gateway Arch National Park
details.imageAlt: Tram Ride to the Top at Gateway Arch National Park

features.name: Old Courthouse
features.description: The restored Old Courthouse has free exhibits and historic courtrooms, including interpretation of the Dred and Harriet Scott cases, during separate daily hours.

details.positionQuality: Old Courthouse, 11, North 4th Street, Downtown, Saint Louis, Missouri, 63101, United States
details.imageAlt: Old Courthouse at Gateway Arch National Park

features.name: Luther Ely Smith Square
features.description: Luther Ely Smith Square creates the paved western approach between the Old Courthouse and Arch entrance, crossing downtown streets before the security checkpoint.

details.positionQuality: Luther Ely Smith Square, Saint Louis, Missouri, United States
details.imageAlt: Luther Ely Smith Square at Gateway Arch National Park

features.name: Gateway Arch Grounds
features.description: The landscaped Arch Grounds are free from 5 a.m. to 11 p.m. with paved accessible paths, lawns and river views but limited shade near midday.

details.positionQuality: Approximate mapped position within Gateway Arch National Park
details.imageAlt: Gateway Arch Grounds at Gateway Arch National Park

features.name: Riverboats at the Gateway Arch
features.description: Riverboat cruises board at the Mississippi levee on separately ticketed seasonal schedules; river stage, weather and private events can alter departures.

details.positionQuality: Approximate mapped position within Gateway Arch National Park
details.imageAlt: Riverboats at the Gateway Arch at Gateway Arch National Park

features.name: Leonor K. Sullivan Boulevard
features.description: Leonor K. Sullivan Boulevard follows the river below the Arch; reach it by the Grand Staircase or longer ramps and check flooding or event closures before descending.

details.positionQuality: North Leonor K. Sullivan Boulevard, Downtown, Saint Louis, Missouri, 63102, United States
details.imageAlt: Leonor K. Sullivan Boulevard at Gateway Arch National Park
